messages:
noah-ecosys: Partner 'ThermalEdge' raised a billing spike after a firmware rollout. They say device counters reset and sent high 'delta' values.
kevin-revops: looking at ingest, we treat incoming "delta" units as additive. If device sent a reset-and-report pattern, we double-count the rollover.
maya-eng: paste example?
noah-ecosys: redacted payloads:
```
{device_id: 'tedge-01', ts: '2026-03-22T05:01:00Z', counter_mode: 'cumulative', counter_value: 12345}
{device_id: 'tedge-01', ts: '2026-03-22T05:02:00Z', counter_mode: 'cumulative', counter_value: 12}
```
noah-ecosys: their SI was pushing a firmware that clears counters on upgrade and emits the new small value immediately. we ingest as if 12= +12 units, not a reset.
kevin-revops: this is classic counter-wrap/reset. aggregator needs monotonic logic: if counter_value < prev_value && counter_mode == 'cumulative' then interpret as reset and compute delta = counter_value + (max_counter - prev_value) OR mark as uncertain if max_counter unknown.
lucas-hw: many of our older devices report counters without declaring max width. new firmware will include counter_width_bits and sequence_no, but not all devices upgraded.
jo-support: partner ops wants immediate protections: they fear being billed for the spike.
maya-eng: short-term mitigation: ingest rule: if counter_mode=='cumulative' and counter_value < prev_value and counter_value < threshold_small (e.g., <1000), tag event as 'probable-reset' and route to held_recon queue. Also emit synthesized delta = counter_value (but do not apply to committed ledger until recon).
kevin-revops: hold policy: hold >0 reconstructed deltas for 48h. For partners with signed mapping/trust, allow auto-correction logic using counter_width if present.
noah-ecosys: partner asks: can we backfill corrected deltas for past 7 days where resets likely occurred?
maya-eng: we can run a backfill that replays events per device with monotonic logic; need device cohort list and a safety threshold to avoid introducing negative deltas. backfill job will produce preview CSV.
opsbot: pipeline alert: high variance on device tedge-01 counter deltas detected at 2026-03-22T05:02:00Z.
kevin-revops: proposed developer plan: 1) ingest: record prev_counter_value, prev_ts, counter_width_bits if present, sequence_no if present, and set event.flag=probable_reset when value drop occurs. 2) aggregator: use monotonic delta when counter_width_bits present; otherwise mark held and compute two candidate deltas (naive delta and reset-delta) in preview. 3) reconciliation UI: show both candidates and let partner claim.
lucas-hw: firmware roadmap: we'll push counter_width_bits and sequence_no fields in SDK v2.1. We'll notify partners and provide a migration timeline.
jo-support: partner comms: brief advisory and a dedicated form to claim held events (fields: event_id, device_id, sample_payload, expected_units). We'll also offer a one-time grace credit for top-5 affected accounts.
maya-eng: metrics: track percent of devices emitting probable_reset, count of held deltas, false-positive rate after partner confirmation. Target FP <1.5%.
kevin-revops: ledger-bridge changes: add hold_for_reset flag and hold_expiry_ts = event_ts + 48h; include candidate_delta values in held_event record. Aggregator nightly reconcile applies partner-approved mapping or auto-applies monotonic formula when confident.
noah-ecosys: legal/sales question: if partners cannot produce mapping and we auto-apply monotonic logic, could revenue allocation change? we need approval for post-invoice adjustments.
jo-support: escalate to billing and legal for policy doc. For now mark affected invoices as provisional.
maya-eng: timeline: ingest tagging + hold flag by EOD tomorrow (owner: maya-eng), aggregator candidate-delta preview by Friday (owner: kevin-revops), partner advisory + claim form by Wednesday (owner: noah-ecosys), firmware SDK update (lucas-hw) in two weeks.
kevin-revops: also add an API endpoint /v1/held-resets to allow programmatic claims and a webhook for partner to acknowledge reconciliations.
opsbot: scheduled job: reset-detection-summarize for partner=thermaledge scheduled 2026-03-23T04:00:00Z.
noah-ecosys: ok thanks. we'll run the backfill preview and share S3 link with partner for review before making invoice changes. sync 10:30am tomorrow. :thumbsup:
thread_text_snippet: ThermalEdge firmware reset caused cumulative counters to drop and inflate billing; plan: detect probable resets, hold >0 candidate deltas 48h, backfill preview, SDK add counter_width_bits and sequence_no
